audit.whatIsWrong: Poppy's R (Keeper's Verdict) grants untargetability through the channel; nothing in the page tells Leona to wait it out rather than dump the combo into it.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule untargetable-dodges-burst — spending E-Q-R into a channeled Keeper's Verdict wastes the whole engage since it dodges the burst.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Feint from your E's 875 range — Heroic Charge only lands inside her 475 dash, so she burns it chasing air, not you.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Faking the engage to bait Heroic Charge for free — you eat her stun before your chain even starts.

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Poppy's Steadfast Presence (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) is matchup-defining — it stops every dash near her, so track the timer and commit only when it's down. - Keep W Eclipse banked for her best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
Dump the combo into Keeper's Verdict
Poppy is untargetable through her own R's channel — spending E-Q-R the instant it lands wastes your engage; wait out the channel or force it early instead.
